title: Italian Customs
description: Learn about Italian customs (aperitivo, greetings, tipping, coffee culture) and discuss social etiquette with a local.
required_interactions: Greeting a local friend or acquaintance
Ordering coffee at a bar and paying at the cassa
Asking about tipping rules in a restaurant
Participating in an aperitivo and understanding the food culture
common_problems: Ordering a cappuccino after lunch or dinner
Paying at the table in a bar without checking if you should pay at the cassa first
Over-tipping or under-tipping in different contexts
Being too formal or too informal with greetings
learner_goals: Correctly greet people in different social settings
Understand the 'coffee at the bar' workflow
Know when and how much to tip
